items.followUp: Write two uses of enzymes in living organisms or industry.

rubric.why: Enzymes are used in the digestion of food.
rubric.how: Award one mark for stating that enzymes help digest food.

rubric.why: Enzymes are used in detergents to help remove stains.
rubric.how: Award one mark for naming detergents as an application.

modelAnswer: Enzymes help in the digestion of food.
Enzymes are used in detergents to help remove stains.

items.followUp: Name one contribution of Abdul Malik Asmai and one book he wrote.

rubric.why: Asmai is known for his work on animals and zoology.
rubric.how: Award one mark for mentioning his contributions to zoology or the study of animals.

rubric.why: Kitab al-Khail is one of Asmai's books.
rubric.how: Award one mark for naming Kitab al-Khail.

modelAnswer: Abdul Malik Asmai is famous for his contributions to zoology and the study of animals.
One of his books is Kitab al-Khail (Book of Horses).
